issue.body:
It seems that the `on_shutdown` event is not run when using reloader to run uvicorn. Given this example app:

```python
from starlette.applications import Starlette
from starlette.responses import JSONResponse
from starlette.routing import Route

async def homepage(request):
    return JSONResponse({'hello': 'world'})

def on_startup():
    print('On startup run')

def on_shutdown():
    print('On shutdown run')

app = Starlette(debug=True, routes=[
    Route('/', homepage),
], on_startup=[on_startup], on_shutdown=[on_shutdown])
```

Here's the output when running with and without `--reload`:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1786830/91698858-0e809000-eb7c-11ea-975a-cbdb34a8f30d.png)

As you can see, the "On shutdown run" output is missing from the latter run.

I'm developing an app that uses threads to listen to outside events, and it is important for me to use `on_shutdown` to close these threads. I'm currently completely unable to use `--reload` in development because of this.

The above example should be reproducible with Python 3.7.3, Starlette 0.13.8 and Uvicorn 0.11.8 at least.
issue.title: on_shutdown event not running when using uvicorn --reload
